eval_prompt: Find Reddit threads where users compare SearXNG with paid web search APIs for coding agents. Return canonical thread URLs, dates, and the specific tradeoffs discussed.
access_gate: Reddit OAuth for native search; public web indexing may be incomplete
success_criteria: Return relevant Reddit thread URLs rather than search-result pages.
Attribute each stated tradeoff to a dated thread or comment.

eval_prompt: Within a Reddit discussion about Google CAPTCHA in SearXNG, find a comment that reports a concrete failure mode or workaround. Return the comment permalink and distinguish firsthand evidence from advice.
access_gate: Reddit OAuth for native search and thread retrieval
success_criteria: Return a canonical comment permalink and its parent thread.
Quote or accurately paraphrase the relevant comment with its date.

eval_prompt: Find Hacker News discussions about using search APIs for AI agents. Return story URLs, dates, and the most relevant discussion threads.
access_gate: Public HN Algolia search; official HN API for item detail
success_criteria: Return canonical HN item URLs and dates.
Identify discussion content, not just linked article titles.

eval_prompt: Find a Hacker News comment comparing self-hosted metasearch with a hosted search API, and return its item permalink and the parent story.
access_gate: Public HN Algolia search; official HN API for item detail
success_criteria: Return a relevant HN comment permalink and parent story.
Attribute the comparison to the comment itself.

eval_prompt: Find recent YouTube videos that demonstrate SearXNG setup or troubleshooting. Return watch URLs, channel names, publish dates, and why each video matches.
access_gate: YouTube Data API key/quota for native search; public web/SearXNG discovery possible
success_criteria: Return canonical video watch URLs with channel and date.
Identify demonstrated setup or troubleshooting, not just keyword matches.

eval_prompt: Find a YouTube video demonstrating a SearXNG Google CAPTCHA failure. Return the video URL and a timestamp or transcript passage that actually shows or explains the failure.
access_gate: Video transcript or playback evidence may require browser access
success_criteria: Return a relevant watch URL.
Verify the claim using a timestamp, transcript, or viewed segment; title alone does not satisfy this case.

eval_prompt: Find public X posts in the last seven days discussing current SearXNG Google CAPTCHA issues. Return canonical post URLs and posting times.
access_gate: X Recent Search requires developer access and usage credits; web indexing is partial
success_criteria: Return dated canonical X post URLs from the requested window.
Do not present old or undated web-index results as recent posts.

eval_prompt: Find an X post recommending a search API for agents and inspect its replies for a concrete limitation. Return the parent post, reply permalink, and dates.
access_gate: X API developer access and usage credits; replies may be inaccessible to web crawlers
success_criteria: Return both canonical post and reply URLs.
Connect the limitation to the correct author and date.

eval_prompt: Find a used Herman Miller Aeron chair listed on Facebook Marketplace within 25 miles of ZIP 10016. Return live listing URLs, asking prices in USD, and locations.
access_gate: Marketplace browser/account and location context; no verified public buyer search API
success_criteria: Return live Marketplace listing URLs for matching chairs.
Verify each asking price and distance or location at evaluation time.

eval_prompt: For a Facebook Marketplace Aeron listing found near ZIP 10016, verify that the listing is still available, identify chair size and condition from the listing, and cite the listing URL.
access_gate: Marketplace browser/account required for reliable availability
success_criteria: Use a canonical live listing URL.
Verify availability and attributes on the listing rather than relying on a search snippet.

eval_prompt: Find the current Amazon.com listing for a Logitech MX Master 3S mouse in graphite. Return the product URL, ASIN, current USD offer price, and seller.
access_gate: Amazon Creators API requires accepted Associates eligibility; live offer needs Amazon page or authorized API
success_criteria: Return a matching Amazon.com product URL and ASIN.
Verify price and seller at evaluation time; do not infer them from web snippets.

eval_prompt: On Amazon.com, compare graphite and pale gray variants of the Logitech MX Master 3S for delivery to ZIP 10016. Return distinct ASINs, current prices, and delivery estimates.
access_gate: Delivery and offer verification may require Amazon account/address; Creators API eligibility gated
success_criteria: Do not conflate color variants or ASINs.
Verify offer prices and delivery estimates using the same address and evaluation time.

eval_prompt: Find Alibaba.com suppliers offering custom printed 12 oz insulated stainless steel bottles. Return supplier/product URLs, minimum order quantities, and quoted unit-price ranges in USD.
access_gate: No verified self-serve buyer catalog search API; quotes and MOQ require source verification
success_criteria: Return Alibaba.com supplier or product URLs, not AliExpress/Taobao.
Verify MOQ and price range on the source page at evaluation time.

eval_prompt: Compare two Alibaba.com suppliers for custom printed 12 oz insulated stainless steel bottles shipped to the United States. State each supplier's MOQ, customization options, and whether pricing is a quote or fixed offer.
access_gate: Seller-authorized Alibaba APIs are not general buyer search; supplier pages or account may be needed
success_criteria: Return two distinct Alibaba.com supplier URLs.
Source MOQ, customization, and quote/offer status separately for each.

eval_prompt: Find restaurants on Uber Eats that offer vegetarian ramen for delivery to ZIP 10016. Return restaurant/menu URLs, item names, and listed prices in USD.
access_gate: Consumer availability depends on full address, account, and time; merchant API is not buyer search
success_criteria: Return relevant Uber Eats restaurant or item URLs.
Verify menu item and price in the consumer surface at the evaluation address/time.

eval_prompt: For a vegetarian ramen item on Uber Eats near ZIP 10016, verify that it can be ordered now for delivery and report current item price, delivery fee, and estimated arrival.
access_gate: Full delivery address and consumer session required for dependable checkout availability
success_criteria: Verify the item remains orderable at the evaluation time and address.
Separate item price, delivery fee, and arrival estimate; mark unavailable if address context is insufficient.

eval_prompt: Find stores on Instacart serving ZIP 10016 that list Oatly Full Fat Oatmilk 64 fl oz. Return product/store URLs, package size, and current USD prices.
access_gate: Instacart native product search and MCP require partner access; consumer price/stock depends on address
success_criteria: Return Instacart product and store context for the exact size.
Verify price and store for the same delivery context at evaluation time.

eval_prompt: Compare availability and current price of Oatly Full Fat Oatmilk 64 fl oz across two Instacart stores delivering to ZIP 10016. Include delivery windows if visible.
access_gate: Full delivery address/account may be required; partner API/MCP provisioning is gated
success_criteria: Check the exact product at two distinct stores.
Verify stock, price, and delivery window with the same address and evaluation time.
